biotools.summary: Finds candidate sites where foreign DNA, such as bacterial or viral DNA, may have been inserted into a host genome. It takes paired-end reads aligned to the host and the per-read output of a taxonomic classifier run on the reads that did not align, and tests each candidate site against the number of chance chimeras that contamination and library preparation would produce at that position, flagging the likely artefacts rather than discarding them. Reads that cross the junction place the insertion point to the base pair. Kraken2, KrakenUniq, Kaiju, Centrifuge, DIAMOND and BLAST tabular output are all accepted, as is any two-column file of read name and taxid. With a GTF or GFF3 annotation it also reports the gene at each site.
